title: Next-investment decision matrix (evidence-power consolidation)

key_facts: 58 international matches gives 80-90% power only for a LARGE 0.0100 RPS edge that the eval showed is absent
a credible moderate-edge (0.0050) claim needs ~150 international matches (~13 tournaments)
more snapshots on the same 58 matches add ~no power (clustering ceiling)
258 exactly-reconciled international matches with verified xG ALREADY exist on disk (statsbomb_cache_audit.total_exact_bridge=258); only 58 were materialized into the snapshot panel
no feature family is live_eligible because no live event-publication latency has ever been measured
in-play xG and the player/lineup plane are prior honest NEGATIVES vs score+Elo

ranking_method: expected information gain per unit effort (qualitative tiers, evidence-anchored); higher = better

recommendations.title: Materialize the 200 already-bridged international matches into the snapshot panel
recommendations.evidence_basis: 258 exact-bridge matches exist on disk but only 58 are in the panel; raising N from 58 toward ~258 is the ONLY lever the power analysis shows moves the needle, and it requires no new data purchase
recommendations.what_it_unblocks: power for a 0.0050 edge rises from 0.49 (58) toward >0.8 (~150-200 matches); first chance to actually detect (or rule out) a moderate in-play correction
recommendations.falsifier: if rebuilding the panel on all 258 bridged matches still yields no candidate beating the W2 reference at >=150 matches with a match-level CI excluding 0, the in-play residual-correction thesis is falsified at the moderate-effect scale

recommendations.title: Add more exact-international matches beyond the current 5 tournaments (AFCON/AsianCup/Gold Cup/qualifiers)
recommendations.evidence_basis: matches are the only power lever; reaching ~150-400 independent matches is required for 0.0050-0.0030 edges; broader confederation coverage also tests transfer
recommendations.what_it_unblocks: moves N past the ~150 credibility threshold and adds confederation diversity for LOCO generalization
recommendations.falsifier: if added competitions do not reconcile EXACTLY (reconciliation_status!=exact) or lack full event timelines, they cannot enter the leakage-safe panel and the lever is blocked

recommendations.title: Run a live event-publication LATENCY study on the cheapest 6 'potentially_live' families
recommendations.evidence_basis: live_readiness: 6 families (score/time/players/cards/subs/lineups) are potentially_live but gated ONLY by unmeasured live latency; this is the single blocker to live_eligible
recommendations.what_it_unblocks: converts research-ready in-play state into a defensible live-eligibility claim with a measured latency budget; necessary precondition for any live use
recommendations.falsifier: if measured live latency exceeds the per-family budget (e.g. cards >15s, score >15s) on >=20 live matches, those families are blocked_by_latency and live use is off the table

recommendations.title: Re-run the power analysis as a sequential/pre-registered acceptance gate at each new-N checkpoint
recommendations.evidence_basis: the power script is deterministic and cheap; rerunning it as N grows pre-commits the effect floor (0.0050) and stops p-hacking via post-hoc N choices
recommendations.what_it_unblocks: honest stopping rule; prevents over-claiming when a candidate squeaks past at small N
recommendations.falsifier: if checkpoints show the achieved power never reaches 0.8 for the pre-registered floor even at max attainable N, the program should declare the in-play edge undetectable rather than keep searching

recommendations.title: Scope a club-football power curve as a separate track (NOT a substitute for international)
recommendations.evidence_basis: club_only_effect is data_insufficient (zero club matches in the eval); club volume could reach 150+ matches fast, but international transfer is unproven
recommendations.what_it_unblocks: a high-volume sandbox to estimate variance/effect for in-play corrections, with an explicit transfer caveat
recommendations.falsifier: if a club-trained correction shows zero or negative transfer to the held-out international matches, the club track does not advance the international claim

recommendations.title: Acquire a live xG / spatial feed (Opta/StatsBomb live) for the xG + chain families
recommendations.evidence_basis: 11 families are blocked_by_missing_provider_contract or no-point-in-time (xG, shot xy, pressure, chains); BUT in-play xG and richer features are prior honest NEGATIVES vs score+Elo
recommendations.what_it_unblocks: would convert the spatial/xG families from offline to potentially-live, but expected predictive payoff is unproven and historically null
recommendations.falsifier: if a fresh power-gated re-test on the expanded match set (post A/B) shows an xG family beating the reference with a CI excluding 0, revisit; absent that, the spend is unjustified

recommendations.title: Acquire in-play odds history + as-of weather to unblock those two no-point-in-time families
recommendations.evidence_basis: market_inplay_odds and weather_venue_travel_rest are blocked_by_no_point_in_time_history; only pre-match odds and static venue/schedule exist locally
recommendations.what_it_unblocks: an in-play market feature and a weather feature would gain backtestable history; but no local evidence yet suggests either beats the existing in-play state
recommendations.falsifier: if, after A/B raise N, a leakage-safe pre-match weather or in-play-odds feature beats the reference on a power-adequate sample, reconsider; otherwise deprioritize

one_line_verdict: Spend effort on MATCHES not features: materialize the ~200 already-bridged international matches (A), then broaden tournaments (B) and measure live latency (C); defer all new-provider spend (F,G) until a power-adequate sample either finds an edge or falsifies the thesis.
note_on_F_G: F and G NAME providers only to describe what data class would be required; they are NO_GO_FOR_NOW and are not purchase recommendations.
